prompt:
Correct these SIX existing Supply Site Management proposals as a single consistent feature set. This is a required accuracy pass against the brief and implemented API. Preserve screen identities and core jobs (directory, add, detail, edit, validation, empty). Use the DIRECTORY screen 24e894e5ada542c9ac2f088ac83dc850 as the ONE shell reference: SAME 232px sidebar and 56px navbar on all six, same spacing/type/header. Aqours teal outlined droplet + Aqours Portal; nav only Dashboard, Reports, Supply sites (selected with neutral grey), Accounts; navbar ONLY breadcrumb and Elena Cruz / Admin account menu. There is no other navbar navigation or search. Do not redesign the whole product.

REMOVE entirely from ALL six:
- Dispatch Supply buttons, dispatch/logistics/telemetry/potable supply wording and implied monitoring.
- Operations, Registry, Audit Logs links; System Settings, Support Documentation links; bells and help inboxes; all global search inputs.
- Facility category, nominal capacity, operational active badges, write policy panels, field codes/field numbers as UI headings.
- Optimistic lock / version / conflict detection / audit author / registered-by / registered via / verified registry / validated PSGC badges and claims.
- Agency endorsements, government footers, system/schema/version/latency/security-level labels, database connected/synchronized claims.
- Raw HTTP/RFC/token/protocol/internal implementation labels in customer-facing text.
- Any statements of actual connectivity, verification, dispatch, sensor readings.
Use only actual record fields: name, canonical address, manual latitude/longitude, ID, createdAt, updatedAt.

Exact content:
Add/edit/validation must share the SAME form layout, labels and field order. Fields: Site name (required <=200), Region, Province conditionally applicable, City/municipality, Sub-municipality conditionally applicable, Barangay, Street or landmark details (required <=500), Latitude [-90,90], Longitude [-180,180]. Address fields are SELECT inputs, not disabled summary cards on Validation; choices retained on failed submit. Sub-municipality shows "Not applicable for this location" for Adams. Do NOT make Facility category, capacity or other fields.
Coordinate helper: "Enter the site's coordinates. The address does not set or verify these values." Only manual numeric fields, no map/GPS/geocoding. Coordinate bounds exactly latitude -90 to 90 and longitude -180 to 180 everywhere, no Philippine territorial subset.
Site details show North Reservoir, exact GUID b561e448-49d0-4f4a-ab82-7d074f8c61e7, full address Near the old bridge, Barangay Adams, Adams, Ilocos Norte, Region I (Ilocos Region), latitude 18.466300, longitude 120.903100, created 27 Oct 2026 16:30 PHT and updated 27 Oct 2026 17:15 PHT. One "Times shown in Asia/Manila" note, no UTC duplicates necessary. No write policy/concurrency/audit section.
Edit Site loads these exact fields, street edited to "Near the old bridge, east gate"; immutable GUID/created timestamp may be small metadata. Only simple "Unsaved changes" indication; discard changes confirmation helper plain copy, no claimed optimistic lock or audit.
Validation only errors for missing site name, missing Street or landmark details, latitude 95.500000 outside -90..90; valid longitude 120.903100 and selected Region I / Ilocos Norte / Adams / Adams retained. Summary links and readable inline errors. Plain language "Check 3 fields before saving"; no HTTP 400 or RFC header.
Directory keep six fixed alphabetic names from brief, no search/filter/sort/export/bulk controls. Total is six, paging "1–6 of 6"; page 1 of 1, page size 20, disabled Previous/Next.
Empty directory keep zero total and first action. Use "0 supply sites"; omit page count when empty or show page 1; NEVER "Page 0 of 0" because API page must be positive. Remove tinted icon block; plain short empty message is enough.
One primary action per screen except empty may repeat the same Add supply site action. Title 24px IBM Plex Sans, body 14px minimum 12px meta, near-black primary, quiet #F4F7F6 frame, white sheets, #1B6C80 brand accent. Avoid uppercase table/form section headers.
Retain "Design preview · Sample records" unobtrusively on all screens. This is FICTIONAL sample review data.
Render at 1440x900 desktop, form content within a practical width and scroll if needed. Responsive web: fold sidebar to named menu at narrow widths, stack form groups and table rows. Do not add mobile app navigation.
Return all SIX corrected screen designs. No implementation outside these Stitch proposals.
